```python
import narwhals as nw

# Scan the parquet file lazily with polars backend
lf = nw.scan_parquet("events.parquet")

# Build the lazy pipeline: filter for status == "ok", select user and duration columns
pipeline = (
    lf
    .filter(nw.col("status") == "ok")
    .select(["user", "duration"])
)

# Materialize the pipeline into a concrete dataframe
df = pipeline.collect()

print(df)
```
